title: Skydive Spaceland Dallas
specs: One of the world’s biggest, most progressive skydiving training centers
Facility includes fully air-conditioned hangar, 40-person bunkhouse, paved runway
Government-issued photo ID required for experienced jumpers
USPA membership card/license required for experienced jumpers
In-date reserve card and seal required if bringing own gear
Rental gear available only for licensed and current jumpers or under direct supervision of instructor
Facility can accommodate up to 11 tandem skydivers on the same flight
Spectators welcome with free parking and covered viewing areas

quotes.author: Ariel Pierce
quotes.text: My husband took me for my 31st Birthday! Camilo was my instructor. Camilo walked me through all the steps we needed to do several times ensuring I had it down, practiced the movements, and answered every question I had. I was very appreciative that he was my instructor and would Definitely come jump again with him! it was also my very first time being on an airplane so that was really cool!!! Thanks again Camilo!!!!

quotes.author: Bob Walsh
quotes.text: I took my wife for a 50th birthday gift and I couldn't let her out do me, so we both jumped. We both had a great time. The staff was so professional from the check in ladies in the front, to the jump teams, and we can not forget the plane pilot. We would really like to thank three people Erik (my wife's tandem free fall partner), Katie (my tandem free fall partner), and Fernanda (my wife's video photographer.)

quotes.author: Jeremy D
quotes.text: Just had an amazing time here at Spaceland Dallas. Kyle was my tandem instructor and Tim did videography(from the sky)... incredible experience! Kyle told me everything I needed to know before jumping and gave all confidence necessary to do so. Can't believe I just jumped out of an airplane! Look forward to coming back. Lots of great info and encouragement from Kyle and Tim both Edit: Just did my second tandem jump with Katie and had an awesome time! Great communication with a smooth flight and landing! Everyone at Spaceland Dallas has been A1

quotes.author: fdownes1
quotes.text: My family gave me a tandem skydive for Christmas. I'm 80 and what a great gift! The staff in the Dallas center was the best. My instructor, Keith Brown, was a hoot and totally professional at the same time. My videographer, Kyle, was super - right with us and he produced a great video of my adventure. I have nothing but positives to say about the entire experience. My wife, daughter and granddaughter came to watch and my daughter and granddaughter are now planning on doing it, too! It is way more fun than scary!

quotes.author: Simon
quotes.text: ​I just did my first tandem skydive ever at Skydive Spaceland and it was an absolute blast! Huge shoutout to my instructor, David, who was incredible. He was super professional, made me feel completely at ease during the training, and made the jump itself an unforgettable experience. If you’re nervous about your first time, ask for David—he’s the best! The whole facility is top-notch and the views were amazing. 10/10 would recommend!
